issue.title: Fix Pill for Last Run State
issue.body: ### Under which category would you file this issue? Airflow Core ### Apache Airflow version `main` ### What happened and how to reproduce it? When filtering by "Last Run" in the DAGs view, the pill for the selected option is cutoff on the bottom. ### What you think should happen instead? Pill should NOT be cutoff when selected. ### Operating System MacOS ### Are you willing to submit PR? - [ ] Yes I am willing to submit a PR! ### Code of Conduct - [x] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
